## Change

Closes or advances issue:
What changed and why; scope and affected contracts/invariants.

## Risk and compatibility

Risk tier and justification; public API, durable format, dependencies, security, resources, and diagnostics impact (or not applicable).

## Verification

Actual commands and results, independent oracle/regression cases, seeds and CI/evidence links. List checks not run and why; identify required extended checks and separate background/release evidence.

## Integration

Docs/ADR, capability and invariant ledger updates as applicable; unresolved issues or rollout/rollback constraints. Request independent review or maintainer decision when required. Merge does not imply release qualification.
